restore_timing: Includes build_restore_plan, explicit synthetic-only decisions, prepare_restore, restore and verification; production application-closed guards stay active in every phase. Final variants additionally include create_document and resume_from_document with its additional guard and checkpoints. Human review/wait time is excluded.
backup_timing: Each trial builds its own backup from the same synthetic source with its production application-closed guard active; backup and complete restore times are recorded separately and summed.
synthetic_decisions: Only within owned fixture source/package/target paths: keep-source for blocking incoming items, keep-target for blocking destination-only items, using production decision APIs. Automatic decisions are left intact. Unoffered decisions or remaining blockers fail the trial.
invariance_check: Source and backup file membership/content hashes are checked outside timing; all metadata invariance is not claimed.
cache_control: not-controlled; no cache flush; alternate baseline/final order
limits: Synthetic profiles also include upstream JSONL/ZST, SQLite and target authentication fixtures, plus a coherent destination-only rollout and active index retained by the reviewed plan.
Fixture generation and backup construction are outside restore timing.
Final restore timing includes durable plan and checkpoints.
Earlier unversioned protocol measurements omitted the comparison plan and common process guards and are not interchangeable with this protocol.
IO ZIP strategies are not metadata-equivalent full restorations.
No duration guarantee and no extrapolation to a real backup.
